desc: 冷银霜玻台上拆解七镜面部防晒详情，从主图到留白收口
name: 霜玻银台清透面部防晒款

shots.intent: 在搜索列表里一眼抓住点击：冷银霜玻台上把整组产品立成唯一主体，干净合规无文字。
用三格并置的空白困扰卡唤起共鸣，把源页的肌肤困扰叙事转成可替换的留白卡位。
shots.textZone: one blank pill slot beneath each of the three plates

shots.intent: 以霜体在玻璃片上推开的成膜微距证明清透质地，替掉源页靠人脸上脸演示的部分。
承接源页四条编号卖点与三项圆形图标的信息屏，用四道留白横条承载可替换卖点。
shots.textZone: right column, four stacked blank rails

shots.intent: 把源页两位模特的使用叙事转成无面容的颈下补涂近景，让买家自我代入而不侵权。
把源页的五枚球形成分位改写成一字排开的五块空白说明牌，只保留五格并列的信息结构。
shots.textZone: one blank pill slot beneath each of the five plates

shots.intent: 收口促单：源页的推荐语与会员码全部剥离，只留一个空白行动按钮卡位与仰视气势。
shots.textZone: lower third, one blank button plate

style.backgroundSystem: seamless pearl-frost studio sweep #F3F3F1 built from stacked frost-etched glass slabs #E4E9EA, brushed stainless steel rails #A9B6BA and blank enamel card plates #F7F8F7, with one deep graphite plate #2B3438 reserved for a single macro frame; horizon-free indoor display architecture, no sky, no water, no sand, no fabric

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool silver frost-etched glass skincare visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of pearl-frost field #F3F3F1, cool silver board #C6CCCE, muted grey-teal accent #7E9BA4 and graphite ink #2B3438; cool 6500K shadowless clamshell light from a large diffusion bank with side black flags, thin specular edges on glass and steel, faint pencil-line contact shadows; stacked frost-etched glass slabs #E4E9EA, brushed stainless steel rails #A9B6BA and blank enamel card plates #F7F8F7 as the only surfaces; modern geometric sans-serif with hairline rules; blank placeholder rails instead of pictograms; stable straight-on product scale with grounded contact shadows; no sky, water, sand, fabric or warm tones, no sun-ray or shield glyphs, no protection-index numerals, no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting.
noDrift: no warm, sand, coral, citrus, amber or mint tones entering any frame
no sky, clouds, horizon, beach or any outdoor scenery
no water, splash, ripple, droplet spheres, bubbles, ice or foam motifs
no sun-ray, shield, clock, hourglass or protection-index glyphs of any kind

style.presentationRules: stable straight-on product scale across the set, units always grounded on a glass slab with a contact shadow, label face toward camera, never floating, never tilted without support
